title: Flaky: VS Code extension E2E dynamic debug configuration test teardown fails with EBUSY resource busy/locked on Windows temp workspace rmdir
test_name: Aspire dynamic debug configuration E2E "after each" hook for "re-resolves the selected AppHost by dynamic configuration name in duplicate-alias workspaces"
job_name: Tests / Run VS Code extension E2E tests / VS Code extension E2E (Windows, dynamic-debug-configuration)
error_pattern:
AggregateError: Dynamic debug configuration E2E teardown failed.
1. Error: EBUSY: resource busy or locked, rmdir 'C:\Users\runneradmin\AppData\Local\Temp\aev-*\workspace\.e2e-dynamic-debug\*'
    at runE2eTeardown (out\test-e2e\test-e2e\helpers\fixtures.js:217:15)
analysis: The failure occurs in the test's 'after each' teardown hook while attempting to rmdir a temp workspace directory on Windows, with an EBUSY (resource busy or locked) error. This indicates a file handle or process is still holding a lock on the directory (e.g., debug adapter/VS Code process not fully released) at teardown time, a Windows-specific timing/contention issue rather than a defect in the PR's changes. The PR only modifies package.json/lockfile dependency versions and does not touch the VS Code extension E2E test infrastructure.
